description.narrative: A portion of this SME loan is reserved for women and young entrepreneurs. These entrepreneurs are key to creating much needed inclusive economic growth in Jordan, which has received well over one million refugees from Syria in recent years. Small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in general have been identified as a strongly underserved market segment in Jordan, while offering the largest potential in terms of volume and combatting unemployment. By targeting SMEs in both growing and underbanked areas of Jordan, SANADCOM supports job creation where it matters most.
